final: WITH account_town_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(*) as account_town_count FROM Financial_Transactions ft INNER JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), town_totals AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(account_town_count) as town_total FROM account_town_counts GROUP BY town_city), joined_with_ratios AS (SELECT atc.account_id, atc.town_city, atc.account_town_count, CAST(atc.account_town_count AS REAL) / CAST(tt.town_total AS REAL) as ratio_to_town_total FROM account_town_counts atc INNER JOIN town_totals tt ON atc.town_city = tt.town_city), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(account_town_count AS REAL)) as avg_count FROM joined_with_ratios) SELECT jwr.account_id, jwr.town_city, jwr.account_town_count, jwr.ratio_to_town_total, CAST(jwr.account_town_count AS REAL) / ac.avg_count as ratio_to_avg_count FROM joined_with_ratios jwr CROSS JOIN average_count ac WHERE ac.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC, jwr.account_id LIMIT 10
